CommunityApplications.Profile:
Official Unraid templates for **Silo** — a self-hosted media server for films and series.
Point Silo at your media shares and stream to your devices at home or away, with direct play, remuxing and hardware-accelerated transcoding handled automatically. A full web client and admin interface ship with the server, and an optional Jellyfin/Emby-compatible API lets you keep using clients such as Infuse, VidHub and Findroid.
This repository provides two templates:
- **Silo** — the media server itself - **Silo-PostgreSQL** — PostgreSQL 18 with the `pgvector` extension, pre-configured for Silo
Redis 6.2 or newer is also required, but no Silo-specific Redis image is necessary. Install any generic Redis container from Community Applications or point Silo at an existing Redis service. Start **Silo-PostgreSQL** and Redis before installing **Silo**; Silo will not start until it can reach both. For Unraid autostart, order both dependencies before Silo and give PostgreSQL time to become ready.
Support is via Discord or GitHub Issues.
